title: One Drawback For Me
text: One Drawback For Me. I am really enjoying this seat. I use it at my vanity. It looks good, is plenty sturdy, and is pretty fairly priced. The thing I'm noticing lately, though, is that the material on the seat is becoming compresses and matted in a very undesirable way. For the price, I don't think this should happen.

product_metadata.title: DEERUN Square Faux Fur Ottoman Bench, Foot Rest Stool/Seat, Modern Upholstered Vanity Dressing Footstool with Removable Metal Legs Design, Accent Ottoman for Home Decor (White)

GOLDEN METAL LEGS: 4 gold metal legs are sturdy and exude a metallic luster, exquisite and sturdy. Durable to with stand full weight capacity. Holds up to 330 lbs. Simply screw metal legs into each corner of the ottoman with the provided screws and your ottoman is ready to enjoy.

ACCENT OTTOMAN: Plush multi-density foam fill allows for a soft yet supportive seat, Perfect for adding to your bedroom or bathroom vanity so your comfy getting ready for the day. Fashionable in every way, you'll love how it brings a unique pop of lively, chic panache to your space. Put your feet up on a faux fur and descend into pure relaxation and comfort.
